subject.title: fix: recover stuck Control UI chat runs

question: Should maintainers pursue this ClawSweeper replacement by porting it to current main and capturing real Control UI proof, waive proof explicitly, or close it and keep the linked issue open for a fresh fix?
rationale: The code path is a plausible bug fix, but the branch targets obsolete files and the remaining blocker is proof or proof waiver plus current-main porting rather than a narrow line-level defect.

options.title: Port and prove current-main fix
options.body: Move the watchdog into the current chat modules and capture redacted browser/gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Override proof explicitly
options.body: A maintainer can accept source/test evidence and own the session/message-delivery risk without real behavior proof.

options.title: Close replacement
options.body: Close this stale replacement and keep the linked issue open for a fresh, current-main PR.

recommendation.title: Port and prove current-main fix
recommendation.body: Move the watchdog into the current chat modules and capture redacted browser/gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current main chat lifecycle files needing a port are from the recent Control UI split refactor.
